extract_protocol_ch1: Acutely extracted brain was sliced at 300um thickness, digested with pronase for 1 hour at RT, triturated and GFP labeled cells were sorted manually. RNA was extracted using PicoPure kit (ThermoFisher, KIT0204).
Extracted RNA was amplified using Ovation RNA-Seq System V2 (NuGEN, #7102). 1~1.5 ug of the amplified material was used for library construction using Encore NGS Multiplex System (NuGEN, #0314).
adapters: truseq
data_processing: Illumina Casava and BCL2FASTQ1.8.3 were used for basecalling

Sequenced reads were trimmed for NuGEN and Illumina adaptor sequences using cutadapt v1.7.1 with parameters --overlap=7 --minimum-length=30. Ribosomal RNA, mitochondrial and phiX sequences were filtered using bowtie2 v2.1.0 with default parameters. Remaining reads were then mapped to mm10 genome using STAR v2.4.0i with parameters  --chimSegmentMin 15 --outFilterMismatchNmax 3.

Uniquely mapped reads were assigned to genes using HTSeq v0.6.1p1 with parameter -s no -m intersection-nonempty and using wgEncodeGencodeVM4Basic annotation downloaded from UCSC with ERCC information added.
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: tab deliminated files include raw counts for each sample
